domain.description: Full RTOS-declared representation, including negative errors/timeouts, zero or invalid handles, processor masks and externally returned values. Required application minimum bits is not substituted for the imported ABI.

rules.ownership: RTOS boundary: task callbacks and kernel calls own interpretation; the enclosing task/module owns each handle. Retain exact typedef and synchronization.
constraints: Preserve RTOS typedefs, callback signatures and address-compatible output objects. Do not treat signed error or ID values as small nonnegative application enums.
Generic RTOS integer aliases UW/INT/UINT/BOOL do not exempt retained application state; those require their own domain/ownership review.
rules.reason: Preserve RTOS typedefs, callback signatures and address-compatible output objects. Do not treat signed error or ID values as small nonnegative application enums.

domain.description: Entire declared C parameter representation reaches the existing function, including out-of-range inputs, enum-invalid values, signedness and any validation sentinel. Retained copies are inventoried separately.

rules.ownership: Caller-owned input or output-address boundary; the callee validates/consumes values under the original API contract.
constraints: Keep public function parameter types and argument conversion behavior. Narrow only validated retained representations, never before the original validation or callback ABI.
rules.reason: Keep public function parameter types and argument conversion behavior. Narrow only validated retained representations, never before the original validation or callback ABI.

domain.description: Existing private helper parameter representation and C argument conversions; no retained object is covered by this policy.

rules.ownership: Invocation-local value; any referenced retained object is independently inventoried.
constraints: Preserve evaluation width, signedness, overflow/shift behavior and invalid-input propagation in private arithmetic helpers. No static storage or member field is waived.
rules.reason: Preserve evaluation width, signedness, overflow/shift behavior and invalid-input propagation in private arithmetic helpers. No static storage or member field is waived.

domain.description: Existing automatic execution temporary representation, including loop terminal values, arithmetic intermediates and address-compatible SDK outputs. This is a preservation constraint rather than a claim of minimum retained-state width.

rules.ownership: Function invocation owns lifetime. Direct address uses are separately recorded; escape/alias absence is not inferred.
constraints: Preserve automatic arithmetic types and evaluation order. This rule excludes static-duration locals, globals and record fields; retained state remains independently reviewed.
rules.reason: Preserve automatic arithmetic types and evaluation order. This rule excludes static-duration locals, globals and record fields; retained state remains independently reviewed.

domain.description: Full pointer/function-pointer ABI representation, including NULL where accepted.

rules.ownership: Caller buffer is borrowed by ADC conversion and used by ADC ISR under ADC_LOCK/ADC_UNLOCK; lifetime extends through completion/timeout cleanup.

rules.reason: Preserve address-compatible UW buffer and lock-protected task/ISR handoff. Packing neighboring flags cannot change atomic storage or synchronization.
rules.synchronization: ADC_LOCK/ADC_UNLOCK around shared driver state, spinlock with SMP or interrupt disable otherwise.

rules.reason: Preserve pointer-width accesses, registration/removal ordering and IRQ synchronization; no shared bitfield storage.
rules.synchronization: Removal disables USB IRQ before unregister/clear; preserve initialization order and pointer-sized accesses.
